description: The bar chart titled "Model Evaluation on Academic and Practical Benchmarks" compares the performance of two models, LLLaMA-3-8B-it and "Ours (Iterative RLHF)," across various academic and practical benchmarks. The horizontal axis lists the datasets and metrics, which include GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (x5), and Chat-Arena-Hard. The vertical axis represents the score percentage, ranging from 0 to 80. The bars are color-coded, with blue representing LLLaMA-3-8B-it and orange representing "Ours (Iterative RLHF)." The chart shows that LLLaMA-3-8B-it generally outperforms "Ours (Iterative RLHF)" in most benchmarks, with the highest score being 80% for GSM-8K and the lowest being 20% for Chat-Arena-Hard. The "Ours (Iterative RLHF)" model shows a more consistent performance across the benchmarks, with scores ranging from 40% to 65%. The chart does not indicate any specific sorting or emphasis on any of the bars.
